statement: simulate and explain are authorized (cosec:simulate, cosec:explain) on the tenant the simulated request's scope resolves to, whose document decides it, never on a tenant the request only names. A request without a principal is decided on tenant (0), as enforcement decides it, so one that names any other tenant is refused 400, after the authorization on (0).
guards: control:ControlPlaneTest#a request without a principal is authorized and decided on tenant (0) only
